speaker: Mr Mohd Fahmi Aliman
text: asked the Minister for Home Affairs (a) in the past three years, how many cases of public urination or similar anti-social behaviour have been reported; (b) how have these statistics changed over time; (c) what penalties or legal actions have been taken against individuals caught engaging in such behaviour; and (d) what steps will be taken to improve the deterrence of anti-social behaviour, including public urination.

speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
text: Depending on the nature of the conduct, such cases may be investigated by the relevant agencies.

speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
text: This requires a case-by-case assessment of the nature and circumstances of the conduct in question.

speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
text: For example, an offence of Public Nuisance may be made out if the offender's act causes any injury, danger or annoyance to the public.
